summary: Implement the released existing-baseline path inside the reusable adapter; the declared residual boundary cannot be accepted.
requiredChanges: Support both establish-baseline and revise-baseline operations exactly as declared by RequirementsGathering, without adapter-selected routing.

When exact RequirementsBaseline and ProjectOverviewBaseline inputs are present, normalize the native full replacement into a valid RequirementsChangeSet and paired ProjectOverviewChangeSetDraft instead of greenfield drafts.
Bind both candidates to the exact prior raw-byte digests and all exact base inputs.

Compute the exhaustive canonical requirements changedSections and project-overview changedSections; derive changeDisposition, including unchanged projection sections, in adapter/runtime code rather than hand-authored host logic.

Add a verifier-reproducible test where a checkpoint-bound clarification response approves ArchitectureRevisionRequest against existing baselines and the terminal result passes the released change-set outcome contract.
Retain native OpenSpec proposal/spec artifacts and provenance and preserve all existing provider, authority, binding, lineage, replay, and package-surface guarantees.

delegating canonical change-set construction or changed-section computation to hand-authored host logic
